title: Remove what the first vector explains
hook: Remove what the first vector explains. Follow the computed steps.

knows: Compare numbers; read a short array, string, tree or graph as drawn.
Arithmetic, function evaluation, vector dot products, small matrices and solving linear equations.
doesNotKnow: Build orthogonal columns by subtracting projections and normalize the residual.

misconception: Subtracting the raw first vector always makes the next vector perpendicular.
objective: Build orthogonal columns by subtracting projections and normalize the residual.

claims.text: The projection coefficient measures how much of the first column lies in the second. Subtracting that measured component leaves a perpendicular residual, which normalization turns into the next orthonormal column.
